statement: Semihomogeneous Chern classes on A times its dual for End(A)=Z and primitive type(1,2) polarization cannot produce Poincare square divided by2; every generated curve class has even mixed Matsusaka coefficient
depends_on: GrossKaurUlirschWerner2026 Theorems2.4/2.6 and Lemma2.9; C.4r; C.4t
notes: Includes virtual classes generated by semihomogeneous bundles and the specified universal-ideal Fourier class. A construction obstruction only; no assertion about arbitrary cycles or arbitrary bundles, and no main-gate movement.
